description: Lists the workspace's open questions — the gap registry: what the map doesn't know yet. Defaults to OPEN gaps. This is where you keep your head — check it before asking the user something you may already have flagged, and compose interview briefs from a subject's open questions.

status.description: Filter by lifecycle stage. Default OPEN.

subjectId.description: Only gaps ABOUT this subject id.

subjectType.description: Only gaps ABOUT this subject type (e.g. compass_page).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: compass_gaps_list
title: List Compass open questions (gaps)
